canonical_identity.title: Language Atlas of India 1991
canonical_identity.corporate_author: Census of India / Office of the Registrar General, India
canonical_identity.canonicalization_note: Catalogue records, hosted PDFs, mirrors, OCR/search extracts and derivative web references are manifestations of one underlying Census atlas and must not be counted as independent corroborating sources.

discovery.observed_content: Searchable PDF text contains distinct Munda and Mundari entries and reports 1991 speaker totals and state/district distributions.
discovery.identity_status: verified at document/search-manifestation level; authoritative-edition metadata and exact printed-page concordance still require repository-level verification

evidence_policy.reason: No cultural or demographic proposition is promoted until an authoritative/lawfully usable manifestation is fixed, immutable bytes are hashed, printed/PDF page concordance is established, and exact table/map/text locators are recorded.
evidence_policy.temporal_scope: 1991 Census only; historical counts/distributions must never be represented as current conditions.
evidence_policy.classification_guard: MUNDA and MUNDARI are kept as distinct Census labels exactly as reported; no equivalence or aggregation is inferred without an explicit Census rule/source.
evidence_policy.rights_guard: Public discoverability or government authorship is not treated as blanket redistribution permission. Preserve source terms and redistribute only when permitted.
evidence_policy.cultural_guard: No ethnographic/cultural inference is licensed by language-count tables alone.

gaps: authoritative Census-hosted manifestation or equivalent edition verification
dependency check against later Census summaries

release_effect.status: verified census identity / locator-ready gap; not evidence-promoted
